habits.desc: Close the distance on foot; back away when crowded.
Throw out quick normals when the opponent is inside poke range.
Guard when an attack is active in reach or a shot is incoming; hold a counter stance.
Answer a jump with the kit's anti-air.
Hit back at a move that was blocked unsafe or whiffed.
Throw or grab at point-blank range.
Fire shots, drones and traps from range; set off own traps up close.
Use heavy normals and special strikes to bait and trade.
Dash forward from far away; dash back or use an escape tool when cornered.
Spend Hype on EX moves and supers, install buffs, and taunt to build Hype when safe.
Spend Composure on a Check against an active attack and on Clear the Air out of a combo.
